sentences.text:
Amrendra Kumar @ Amrendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of
Bihar on 7 November, 2025

In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.46343 of 2025
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-7 Year-2024 Thana- Kinjar District- 
 ======================================================
 Amrendra Kumar @ Amrendra Kumar Singh S/O Braj Mohan Singh @ Braj
 Mohan Yadav R/O Village- Tekari, P.S- Kinjar, Dist.- Arwal.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ramakant Singh, Adv
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Dilip Kumar No. 1, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice S. B. Pd. Singh
 Oral Order
3 07-11-2025

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with kinjar P.S.Case No. 07 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code 3.

As per the prosecution case, the petitioner while working as Ward Member-cum- Chairman of Implementation and Managing Committee along with co-accused Sonafi Devi defalcated an amount of Rs. 2, 58,914 from the govt fund.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence as alleged in the FIR.
The petitioner is Ward Member -cum- Chairman of Implementation and Managing Committee, of Nagava Gram Panchayat.

It is further submitted that the co-accused Sonfi Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46343 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 Devi and the petitioner withdrawn total amount of Rs. 34,63,709/- from the Govt Bank Account but they have completed work of only Rs. 3204795/- and Rs. 2,58,914/- was defalcated by the petitioner.
It is clearly mentioned on the said impugned order that co-accused Sonfi Devi has made false signature on the cheque and withdrawn money from the Govt Bank Account.
Similarly situated, co- accused Sonfi Devi has already been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 26.06.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 38773 of 2024.

5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that petitioner had defalcated the govt money and a report of Panchayat Sachiv has also been Amrendra Kumar @ Amrendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43325335/
1 annexed in case diary in which the said allegation of defalcation of Rs.2,58,914/- by the petitioner and co-accused Safi Devi has been substantiated.

entities.text: Amrendra Kumar @ Amrendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The other co-accused has been granted privilege of Anticipatory bail because of being lady/ women as per the said order.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and the material available on record and specially keeping in view the defalcation of government/ public money, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail, accordingly his prayer Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.46343 of 2025(3)
dt.07-11-2025 for anticipatory bail stands rejected.

N.K/-
 (S. B. Pd. Singh, J)
